post.description: Needs EDIT. Only png, jpeg, webp and gif up to the configured size are accepted. The size is reserved against the workspace quota; the returned policy pins the key, the content type and the exact length. POST `fields` followed by the file to `url`, then call `complete`.

get.description: At most one VIEW link (the published page) and one EDIT link. The EDIT secret is not listed: it is shown once, when the link is created.
get.summary: Public links of a document (MANAGE, or EDIT as the author)

post.description: MANAGE, or EDIT as the author; 10 per hour per user. VIEW: collab is asked to write its buffer first (2 s; `flushed` is false when it could not), the slug is created once and returned again when the page is published again. EDIT: every call issues a new secret and invalidates the previous URL, closing its open guest sessions.
post.summary: Publish the page (VIEW) or enable editing by link (EDIT)

patch.summary: Change or remove the expiry of a link

delete.description: Unpublishes the page (the slug stays reserved for it) or ends editing by link. Revoking an already revoked link does nothing.

get.description: For `/e/<token>`. 404 for an unknown or replaced secret, 410 `LINK_EXPIRED` for an expired or revoked link and 410 `DOCUMENT_DELETED` for a deleted document.

info.title: Collab Docs API
info.description: REST API of the Collab Docs workspace. Document content is edited over WebSocket (CRDT).

accessToken.description: Access JWT, also set as the httpOnly cookie cd_at. Usable as a Bearer token.

parentId.description: Omit to create at the workspace root
null when the parent is hidden from the caller

documentCount.description: Live documents restored together with it

canRestore.description: Whether the caller may restore it

parentId.description: New parent; null moves to the root

beforeId.description: Place the document right before this sibling

afterId.description: Place the document right after this sibling

email.description: Must belong to a registered user

ticket.description: Short-lived (60 s) token for one WebSocket connection; fetch a new one per attempt.

wsUrl.description: Base URL for y-websocket; the provider appends `/<documentId>?ticket=<ticket>`. Closes: 4401 ticket invalid (fetch a new one), 4403 no access, 4404 not found, 4410 deleted, 4429 rate limited.

title.description: The document title when the snapshot was taken
The document title when the snapshot was taken

content.description: The content as sanitised ProseMirror JSON ({ type: "doc", content: [...] })

title.description: The document title when the snapshot was taken

flushed.description: false when the collaboration service could not write its buffer first, so the snapshot may miss the last seconds of editing

filename.description: Original file name; its extension has to belong to `mime`

fields.description: Form fields to send before the `file` part (the file must be the last field)

mode.description: VIEW publishes the page at /p/<slug>; EDIT lets anyone with the secret URL edit the document as a guest

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working; must lie in the future. Omitted or null: never.

token.description: EDIT links: the secret that goes into /e/<token>. Shown once, only its hash is stored.

flushed.description: VIEW links: false when the collaboration service could not write its buffer first, so the page may miss the last few seconds of editing

expiresAt.description: The new expiry; null removes it

description.description: First 160 characters of the text, for the meta description
